digest.component_or_area: ADR 0098: operation-scoped config and provider composition
propositions: Rebar must compose immutable non-secret operation snapshots separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries.
Provider-native authentication and session injection must occur at Rebar-owned factory construction time, retaining upstream credential lifecycle ownership outside Rebar.

Operational certificate startup composition requires exactly one source (file path or multiline value), single validation, process-owned file permissions (0700/0600), and context-local signer/principal/push policy without application runtime SSM/boto3/region coupling.
Static credential rotation occurs only through restart/redeploy cycles; SDK-owned in-process refresh remains separate and is not Rebar's responsibility.
Subprocess environment rules must not include global os.environ mutation; child process credential propagation is deployment-scoped and explicitly managed at invocation points.
